get.summary: List all sections for a channel
get.description:
🔓 **Authentication Optional**: This endpoint works without authentication but provides additional features when authenticated with a valid JWT token in the Authorization header (Bearer <token>).


        Retrieves all channel sections ordered by position (ascending).

        **Public Access:**
        - Public channels: All sections visible to everyone
        - Private channels: Only visible to channel owner (requires auth)

        **Filtering:**
        - Optional `type` query parameter to filter by section type

        **Pagination:**
        - Cursor-based pagination with configurable limit (default: 20, max: 50)

post.description:
🔒 **Authentication Required**: This endpoint requires a valid JWT token in the Authorization header (Bearer <token>).


        Creates a new section for organizing channel content.

        **Authorization:**
        - User must be authenticated
        - User must be able to edit the channel layout (owner; channel admin once channel roles exist)
        - subscribed_channels / liked_videos: channel owner only, with `consent: true`

        **Position:**
        - Appended last; a channel_spotlight is always first
        - Use PATCH /sections/reorder to change order

        **Limits:** 12 sections per channel; one of each automatic type (shorts and
        live_streams: one per sort / filter); one spotlight.

        **Errors** carry a stable `code`: validation_failed, section_limit,
        section_type_limit (409), owner_consent_required (403), consent_required,
        invalid_video, invalid_playlist, invalid_channel.

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid authentication token

error.example: Missing or invalid Authorization header. Expected: Bearer <token>

409.description: This section type is already on the channel

get.summary: List channel sections with populated content
get.description:
🔓 **Authentication Optional**: This endpoint works without authentication but provides additional features when authenticated with a valid JWT token in the Authorization header (Bearer <token>).


        Retrieves all channel sections with auto-populated content for dynamic types.

        **Public Access:**
        - Public channels: All sections visible to everyone
        - Private channels: Only visible to channel owner (requires auth)

        **Population:** every section type is populated on the server
        (`populatedContent`) and carries `isEmpty`. Empty sections are left
        out, except for people who can edit the channel, who get them with
        `emptyHint` (noContent, consentMissing, communityTabHidden,
        loadFailed) and `canEdit: true`. subscribed_channels and liked_videos
        populate only with the channel owner's opt-in.

        **Caching:** signed-out responses are cached at the edge for 60 s.

        **Query Parameters:**
        - populate: Include populated content (videos/playlists/channels)
        - type: Filter by section type
        - limit: Maximum sections to return (default: 20, max: 50)

200.description: Successfully retrieved channel sections with content

patch.description:
🔒 **Authentication Required**: This endpoint requires a valid JWT token in the Authorization header (Bearer <token>).


        Reorders all sections for a channel in a single atomic operation.

        **Authorization:**
        - User must be authenticated
        - User must own the channel

        **Validation:**
        - Must include ALL existing section IDs
        - No duplicates allowed
        - All IDs must exist and belong to channel

        **Atomicity:**
        - Either all sections reorder or none (rollback on error)

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid authentication token

error.example: Missing or invalid Authorization header. Expected: Bearer <token>

get.description:
🔓 **Authentication Optional**: This endpoint works without authentication but provides additional features when authenticated with a valid JWT token in the Authorization header (Bearer <token>).


        Retrieves details of a specific channel section by ID.

        **Public Access:**
        - Public channels: Section visible to everyone
        - Private channels: Only visible to channel owner (requires auth)

put.description:
🔒 **Authentication Required**: This endpoint requires a valid JWT token in the Authorization header (Bearer <token>).


        Updates an existing channel section with partial data.

        **Authorization:**
        - User must be authenticated
        - User must own the channel

        **Notes:**
        - Partial update (only provided fields are updated)
        - Cannot change section type (delete and recreate instead)
        - Cannot change position (use PATCH /sections/reorder)

delete.description:
🔒 **Authentication Required**: This endpoint requires a valid JWT token in the Authorization header (Bearer <token>).


        Deletes a channel section permanently.

        **Authorization:**
        - User must be authenticated
        - User must own the channel

        **Notes:**
        - Deletion is permanent and cannot be undone
        - Other sections' positions are automatically updated

put.summary: Save the playback position of a video (last writer wins)
put.description:
🔒 **Authentication Required**: This endpoint requires a valid JWT token in the Authorization header (Bearer <token>).

🔒 Requires authentication. Stores the position for every device of the user. The write with the newest `clientUpdatedAt` wins; an older write returns `applied: false` with the stored state, so clients converge without conflicts. Creates the history entry when missing. Paused history stores nothing.

clientUpdatedAt.description: Device time of this position (ISO 8601); the newest write wins

200.description: Stored, or the newer stored state

applied.description: false: a newer state was already stored; `state` is that state

paused.description: Watch history is paused: nothing was stored

updatedAt.description: Last-writer-wins clock: client time of the write, clamped to server time + 5 min

serverUpdatedAt.description: Server time of the last write; pass the newest as `since` for incremental sync
